A consistent positive mean_bias across sources that share a common processing lineage (e.g. all project lidar and photogrammetry) but not in external reference data (MassGIS) points to a datum or reprojection issue rather than a ground-finding problem.

Predicted vs. observed by source

Bias correction

The results above suggest a systematic bias in the UAS-based data sources, possibly a datum shift or other projection issue. This apparent bias swamps other sources of error and makes comparison difficult. The plots and tables here use data with the per-source bias removed.
